items.title: ElevenLabs on AI Gateway
items.summary: Vercel and  are partnering to bring 14 ElevenLabs models to . To celebrate the launch, all ElevenLabs models are 50% off on AI Gateway for the first 14 days, through November 9th.ElevenLabsAI GatewayAI Gateway supports six different types of ElevenLabs audio models:All of these audio models are accessible through a single gateway API key. Your app or agent can transcribe what a user says, reason over it with your choice of hundreds of models, then answer in an ElevenLabs voice. You can also create soundtracks with generated music and sound effects. Every request lands in the same usage, cost, and trace views as your other AI Gateway traffic.AI Gateway gives you access to 14 ElevenLabs models, spanning speech to text, realtime voice, and music. turns a user's speech into text while they are still talking. A language model of your choice then writes the answer. , a low-latency ElevenLabs voice model, reads that answer aloud as it streams in, so the user hears the reply begin before the model finishes writing it.Scribe v2 RealtimeEleven Flash v2.5Because each step is its own model, you can swap the transcription, language, or speech model without touching the rest of the pipeline.In the example below, a user asks whether they’ll make a connecting flight. The text model combines flight status and gate distance to answer, then the speech model delivers the response. and  run the whole spoken conversation in one model, which suits conversations where users expect natural back-and-forth, like a support call or an in-app assistant. Both models take the user's audio in and speak a reply back over a single WebSocket session, so there's no separate transcription or speech step to wire up.Eleven Realtime v1 MaxEleven Realtime v1 MiniEleven Realtime hears “Can I change the delivery address for my order?” and responds “I can help with that. What’s your order number?” over one WebSocket session.In the browser, connect with the  hook from , which handles the WebSocket connection, microphone capture, and audio playback. In the hook's , set an ElevenLabs voice ID and . These models support semantic voice activity detection (VAD) to decide when the user has finished speaking, but they don't support . Name a genre, a mood, or the instruments you want, and the model returns a finished track at the length you ask for, with or without vocals. For more control, you can lay out a song section by section and give each section its own style and length.Music v2.5Music v2 works the same way for shorter sounds, such as footsteps, a door slamming, or rain that loops under a game level.Sound Effects v2All three models use , with  describing the sound you want instead of words to read aloud. You assign a voice to each line, and each change of voice starts a new turn. A two-host podcast or a scene with a full cast comes back as one continuous recording, so there are no separate clips to stitch together.Eleven v4Eleven v4 TurboEleven v3AI Gateway provides a unified API for calling models, tracking usage and cost, and configuring retries, failover, and performance optimizations for higher-than-provider uptime.
